naslov: Crvena Zvezda loses Stefan Miljenovic after arthroscopic ankle surgery
tekst:
By Johnny Askounis/ info@eurohoops.net
Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet announced Tuesday that Stefan Miljenovic underwent arthroscopic ankle surgery, sidelining the 25-year-old guard.
The Belgrade club stated that he has already started rehab. The procedure addressed a lingering joint issue that bothered the Serbian national team player since last summer.
Miljenovic played sparingly early in his 2026–27 journey while managing the ailment. He logged nine total minutes across the first three rounds of the EuroLeague Regular Season, hitting one three-pointer. In early October, he also made two appearances in the AdmiralBet ABA League, averaging 2.0 points. This comes after his debut EuroLeague campaign last year, where he averaged 2.2 points over 13 appearances.

The team coached by Ibon Navarro is healthy otherwise across the squad. Zvezda confirmed Miljenovic is the lone player on the injury report, leaving the rest of the roster available for a demanding stretch ahead.
The timing forces roster adjustments during a strong run. They carry a 7–3 W-L tally in the EuroLeague, sitting in a six-way tie for second place before a Round 11 road game against Real Madrid at Movistar Arena on Thursday. Regionally, they lead Group A of the ABA League Regular Season at 5–1, tied with Buducnost VOLI.
Miljenovic transitioned to his current team in 2025 after spending a successful two-year tenure developing with Mega Superbet/MIS. Last summer, he made his FIBA debut with the senior national team of Serbia, earning his first four caps in FIBA World Cup 2027 Qualifiers. He delivered well-rounded performances, putting up 11.3 points, 4.8 assists, 3.8 rebounds, and 1.0 steals per contest.
